purpose: Descriptive layerwise lines requested by user, separate from the failed causal-study gate.
selection: f07 is the only family on which Qwen 1.5B, Qwen 7B and Llama 3B passed all four Agent questions. This choice uses known behavioral outcomes and cannot serve as a held-out test. Qwen 0.5B is shown as an incompetent diagnostic model.
stages: Embedding and every block output, with depth normalized as block index divided by number of blocks.
primary_quantity: For each voice and site, relative separation between the A-Agent and B-Agent residual states: ||h_A-h_B|| / ((||h_A||+||h_B||)/2).
visualization: Four panels: active and passive role reversal crossed with event-end and answer-prompt-end site. One line per model; Qwen 0.5B dashed due failed competence.
interpretation: Observable state divergence only. It may reflect lexical exchange, tokenization, syntax, answer state or generic block schedules. Do not infer a shared semantic-role path, causal mechanism or model-family effect from one selected family. No patching or new gate decision.
